## Independence Realty Trust to Expand Its Board; Appoints Two Centerspace Directors


November 25, 2026


PHILADELPHIA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT) (“IRT”), a multifamily real estate investment trust (“REIT”), today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) approved an increase in the size of the Board from ten to eleven directors, with such increase to become effective as of, and contingent upon, the completion of IRT’s merger with Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) (the “Merger”). The Board also appointed John A. Schissel and Ola Oyinsan Hixon to the Board, with such appointments to become effective as of, and contingent upon, the completion of the Merger. Each of Mr. Schissel and Ms. Hixon will serve until IRT’s next annual meeting of stockholders and until his or her successor is duly elected and qualified.


“We are pleased to welcome John and Ola to IRT’s Board,” said Scott Schaeffer, Chairman and CEO of IRT. “Their appointments will broaden the experience and diversity of perspectives represented on our Board, and they bring invaluable skills and expertise from their leadership in the REIT and capital markets industries.”


Mr. Schissel has served as a trustee of Centerspace since 2016 and as that board’s chairman since 2021. He has over 30 years of experience in the capital markets and as an executive for both public and private real estate company platforms, including his current role as President and Chief Operating Officer of Carr Properties, a privately held REIT. Mr. Schissel previously served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Invitation Homes Inc. (NYSE: INVH), the nation’s largest owner and operator of single-family rental homes, and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of BRE Properties, Inc., a formerly NYSE-listed multifamily REIT that was acquired by Essex Property Trust (NYSE: ESS) in 2014.


Ms. Hixon has served as a trustee of Centerspace since 2024, and as a member of that board’s Compensation and Nominating and Governance Committees. She is a Managing Director at PGIM and a portfolio manager on its U.S. Value-Add equity team, where she is responsible for investment strategy, transactions, asset management, and investor relations, primarily for the firm’s affordable housing and impact fund strategies. Ms. Hixon previously served as a Principal at KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE: KKR), overseeing portfolio and asset management for real estate private equity funds. Previously, Ms. Hixon worked at Blackstone Inc. (NYSE: BX), where she managed the multifamily portfolio company, LivCor, and the single-family home portfolio company Invitation Homes, and earlier worked at The JBG Companies, UBS, and the investment banking division of Citigroup.


**About Independence Realty Trust, Inc.**


Independence Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: IRT), an S&P MidCap 400 Company, is a REIT that owns and operates multifamily communities across non-gateway U.S. markets. IRT’s investment strategy is focused on gaining scale near major employment centers within key amenity-rich submarkets that offer good school districts and high-quality retail. IRT’s main investment objective is to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns to stockholders through diligent portfolio management, strong operational performance, and a consistent return on capital through distributions and capital appreciation. More information may be found on IRT’s website,[www.irtliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.irtliving.com&esheet=54646350&newsitemid=20261125855211&lan=en-US&anchor=www.irtliving.com&index=1&md5=8c6e1676b654ac15c16792f476094ebf) .


**About Centerspace**


Centerspace (NYSE: CSR) is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of September 30, 2026, Centerspace owned 47 apartment communities consisting of 10,456 units located in Colorado, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the Minnesota Star Tribune. For more information, please visit[www.centerspacehomes.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerspacehomes.com&esheet=54646350&newsitemid=20261125855211&lan=en-US&anchor=www.centerspacehomes.com&index=2&md5=6b4a2116c4e19a883f42b922af82d93c) .
